description: Exploit: non-uniform trim. Run it on the I-40/0/30/30 successor if kept, otherwise on the E036 tip. Remove only 12 steps from the 20 px phase (231 → 219 total steps). The 28 px and 32 px phases keep their exact absolute step counts. The whitening-bias detach stays at the same absolute step (about 46). The group-1 freeze still covers the same last ~58 steps. The LR triangle and the Lookahead ramp are stretched to the new total as fractions, as in E023/E027. No new shapes, so no recapture is needed; error_on_recompile stays on. Run held-out seeds 3–12 in the same session. Keep if seeds 0–2 ≥ 0.753 and held-out ≥ 0.7545.
